description: Get the available daily snow, temperature, freezing level and wind-hold risk forecast, up to 10 requested days.

days.description: Number of forecast days to return, 1 to 10. Defaults to 7. Fewer may come back if the forecast is shorter.

resort.description: Resort name such as 'Zermatt', or numeric resort id such as 675 (from search_resorts)

name: get_forecast
title: Get forecast
